description: This file defines various Pydantic models for API response schemas, including envelopes for success, error, health, readiness, metrics, tests, scenarios, reports, and accepted jobs, as well as utility functions.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Represents an error payload conforming to OpenAPI specifications.

classes.name: EnvelopeOk
classes.description: Generic success envelope with status 'ok' and optional data.

classes.name: EnvelopeError
classes.description: Error envelope with status 'error' and error details.

classes.name: HealthData
classes.description: Contains health status information including uptime, version, and health of database and Xena.

classes.name: ReadyData
classes.description: Indicates whether the service is ready to serve traffic.

classes.name: EnvelopeCurrentMetrics
classes.description: Envelope for current metrics data, specialized from EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeHealth
classes.description: Envelope for health status data, specialized from EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeReady
classes.description: Envelope for readiness status, specialized from EnvelopeOk.

classes.name: EnvelopeTestStartAccepted
classes.description: Envelope for accepted test start responses.

classes.name: EnvelopeTestStopAccepted
classes.description: Envelope for accepted test stop responses.

methods.name: now_utc
methods.description: Utility function to generate current UTC datetime.
